# foreman_commonparameter (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_commonparameter" "puppet_server" {
  name = "puppet_server"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the commonparameter to look up.

### Read-Only

- `hidden_value` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `parameter_type` (String) Type of value
- `value` (String)
